gate_findings.evidence: Claim IDEA khop claim_ceiling. Artifact khong drift: 3/3 khop sha256. Ba muc catalog moi (I-PARAM, BOX-PARAM, CI-PARAM) dung la MARKER giong ST-PARAM: parametric=true va KHONG mot truong so hoc nao - tuc khong ai bia dac trung tiet dien vao do, dung safety_note thu hai cua hop dong.

Hang rao girder_count duoc dung DUNG cach va toi tu kiem bang chay chu khong doc code. Cau truc: global ha 2->1, roi siet lai minimum=2 trong khoi if/then cua bon ho con lai; chi box_girder_parametric_v1 theo global. Tu dung state va goi validate_design_state: girder_count=1 duoc chap nhan CHI cho box, bi tu choi cho super_t_parametric_v2, i_girder va composite_i; girder_count=0 bi tu choi cho CA BON ho; toi them mot ca thu ba ngoai hop dong la girder_count=-1 va cung bi tu choi cho ca bon. Day la bay chinh ma safety_note canh bao (allOf la phep AND nen khong noi duoc rang buoc global tu khoi if/then) va nguoi nop da khong roi vao.

Tu chay lai: tests/test_multifamily_contract.py 11/11 xanh, tests/test_state.py 27/27 xanh nen BAY input_hash gold case giu nguyen - noi hop dong khong dich mot byte nao cua canonical_json. KET QUA DICH THUC SU: truoc BRD-035 ca ba ho moi deu chet o SCHEMA-001 truoc khi solver kip chay; sau khi sua, ca bon ho dung duoc BridgeDesignState hop le va evaluate_candidate di den tan verifier hinh hoc L0, tra GEOMETRY_INVALID kem rule that (GEOM-001, CONS-001, va SOLVER-COMPOSITE-001 cho ho composite). Tuc hop dong khong con chan, con viec phuong an co kha thi hay khong thi cac rule ky thuat quyet dinh - dung nhu muc tieu cua task. Cong hard gate SOLVER-COMPOSITE-001 van bat dung nhu grammar_bindings cua BRD-029 khai.

Task nay chi noi hop dong va them muc catalog marker; khong dua ra bat ky claim nao ve kha nang chiu luc. Tran claim rieng cua tung ho trong grammar_bindings (box va composite dang o IDEA vi he so phan bo ngang ngoai mien ap dung) khong bi task nay dong den va van chan nhu cu.
